outcome_definition: Outcome = limit of blank (highest signal reached by blank samples), for ONE assay under ONE supermix lot / thermocycling profile. Same assay, different conditions => different LoB; this is the variability being recorded, not an assay-to-assay difference.

Outcome = lowest low-concentration sample still detected by the named method, in copies per uL. This is a LIMIT COMPARISON between digital, quantitative and nested PCR on the same samples. It compares detection of a CONCENTRATION, and is not a variant-detection conversion rate.
